explanation: Cervantes called Lope de Vega a 'monster of nature' for his output. He claimed to have written about 1,500 plays, and several hundred survive, against roughly 38 by Shakespeare.

claims.text: About 38 plays by William Shakespeare survive, counting the collaborations usually included in his works.
More than 300 plays by Lope de Vega survive.
Miguel de Cervantes called Lope de Vega a 'monster of nature'.
Lope de Vega claimed to have written about 1,500 plays.
Several hundred of Lope de Vega's plays survive.
